How much is a used Fujifilm X100V worth?

The Fujifilm X100V became famous on social media and is one of the few cameras whose used price stayed high for years. That also makes it a target for scams.

Updated 2026-11-06 · by FlipLens

Which one do you have?

The X100V (2020) has a fixed 23 mm lens, a hybrid viewfinder and a tilting screen. It is often confused with the older X100F and the newer X100VI (2024). The model name is on the top plate.

What decides the price

  • Model: X100VI, X100V and X100F are three price levels.
  • Finish: silver and black.
  • Condition: lens glass, screen, scratches on the top plate.
  • Accessories: original box, battery, lens cap, adapter ring and filter.

Check before you buy

  • Take photos and check the lens for haze, scratches and fungus.
  • Test the viewfinder in both modes and the tilting screen.
  • Compare the serial on the camera and the box.
  • Buy only with buyer protection: very low prices are often scams.

Where it sells best

Sells fast on eBay and camera marketplaces. Show sample photos and the serial number to build trust.

Today's price

Prices for a used Fujifilm X100V change every week, so this page gives no fixed numbers. Questions

How much is a used Fujifilm X100V worth?

It depends on condition, finish, accessories and authenticity. Prices change weekly, so check today's value: type "Fujifilm X100V" and the condition into FlipLens (fliplens.eu), which compares current eBay listings in the UK and five EU countries and shows the expected sale price and the most worth paying.

Why is the X100V so expensive used?

Demand from social media and limited supply kept prices high. Prices have moved since the X100VI launch, so check the current market.

Does the X100VI lower the value of the X100V?

A new model usually lowers the price of the previous one, but demand for the X100V has stayed strong.
